rows.title: Purchases are spending
rows.defect: a purchase's sign is not flipped, so spending reads negative

rows.title: Unreviewed keeps totals unknown
rows.defect: totals are stated while rows are still unreviewed
rows.test: one unreviewed $10.00 keeps spending null

rows.title: No records is unknown
rows.defect: an empty period is called complete
rows.test: an empty month is not $0 spent

rows.title: Changed facts void the review
rows.defect: the review is not compared with the row's current facts
rows.test: a $100 review does not cover the bank's corrected $90

rows.title: The newest review wins
rows.defect: the first review seen wins
rows.test: a later "unknown" takes the expense back

rows.title: A purchase is money going out
rows.defect: the purchase direction check is dropped
rows.test: an "expense" on a $50 credit is not believed

rows.title: A refund takes the purchase's category
rows.defect: the refund's own category is used
rows.test: the $40 refund lands under Clothing

rows.title: A full refund is a refund
rows.defect: a refund equal to the purchase is rejected
rows.test: $120 back on a $120 purchase counts

rows.title: Refunds together cannot pass the purchase
rows.defect: refunds are checked one by one, never together
rows.test: $60 + $60 back on $100 is not believed

rows.title: No refund before the purchase
rows.defect: the date order check is dropped
rows.test: a refund dated the day before is not believed

rows.title: Transfer legs must match to the cent
rows.defect: the amounts of the two legs are not compared
rows.test: -$500.00 and +$499.99 are not a transfer

rows.title: Both legs say the same thing
rows.defect: the partner's kind is not compared
rows.test: a transfer leg paired with a card-payment leg is not believed

rows.title: The bank's own transfer label
rows.defect: the provider's transfer flag is ignored
rows.test: an unreviewed bank-labeled transfer is a transfer

rows.title: Loans are not income
rows.defect: loan proceeds are added to income
rows.test: a $5,000 loan is not in income

rows.title: Other currencies stay aside
rows.defect: the currency check is dropped
rows.test: a EUR row is counted aside, not as a record

rows.title: Categories in name order
rows.defect: the category order is reversed
rows.test: Dining before Uncategorized

rows.title: The last day is in the range
rows.defect: the range's last day is left out
rows.test: Oct 31 counts in Oct 1 to Oct 31

rows.title: One account means one account
rows.defect: the account filter is dropped
rows.test: the checking report has 2 records, not 3

rows.title: Conflicting copies stop the report
rows.defect: a later copy silently replaces the earlier one
rows.test: the same id at $1.00 and $1.01 throws

rows.title: Too big is unknown
rows.defect: a total past 2^53 is rounded and shown
rows.test: MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1 cents is null

rows.title: The totals carry their as-of
rows.defect: the report states no as-of for its money (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: the oldest counted fetch, Oct 3 07:15 UTC; none if a counted row has no fetch time

rows.title: Unknown fetch time, unknown as-of
rows.defect: any fetch time is enough to state an as-of
rows.test: one counted row without a fetch time makes the as-of null
